data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

## What to build
Write a failing behavioral test for `plugins/dso/scripts/audit-closure-checks-migration.sh`.

Test file: `tests/scripts/test-audit-closure-checks-migration.sh`

## Fixture setup
Create a temporary ticket repo with 3 epics/stories:
- Ticket A (epic, status=open): description does NOT contain `## Closure Checks`
- Ticket B (story, status=open): description does NOT contain `## Closure Checks`
- Ticket C (epic, status=closed): description CONTAINS `## Closure Checks`

## Assertions (all must FAIL when script does not exist — RED)

1. Script exists at `plugins/dso/scripts/audit-closure-checks-migration.sh` (assert exists)
2. Script is executable (assert -x)
3. Script exits 0 when run against fixture with 2 tickets lacking section
4. Output contains exactly 2 lines (one per unmigrated ticket)
5. Each line is tab-separated: `<ticket-id>\t<type>\t<status>\t<title>`
6. Ticket A appears in output (epic, open, correct title)
7. Ticket B appears in output (story, open, correct title)
8. Ticket C (has Closure Checks) does NOT appear in output
9. Script exits 1 when run against fixture where all tickets have `## Closure Checks`
10. Script exits 2 when run against non-existent tracker dir (error case)

## Suite-runner guard (required pattern)
```bash
if [ "${_RUN_ALL_ACTIVE:-0}" = "1" ] && [ ! -f "$AUDIT_SCRIPT" ]; then
    echo "SKIP: audit-closure-checks-migration.sh not yet implemented (RED) — tests deferred"
    printf "PASSED: 0  FAILED: 0\n"
    exit 0
fi
```

## Test file header (required comment)
```
# These tests are RED — the audit script does not yet exist.
# Tests MUST FAIL until audit-closure-checks-migration.sh is implemented (task T2).
```

## Implementation approach
- Use `clone_ticket_repo` from `tests/lib/git-fixtures.sh` (see test-ticket-migrate-brainstorm-tags.sh for pattern)
- Write CREATE event JSON files directly to fixture tracker dirs (do NOT use ticket CLI in tests)
- Source `tests/lib/assert.sh` for assertions
- Use `mktemp -d` for temp dirs; trap cleanup on EXIT

## Verify
Run: `bash tests/scripts/test-audit-closure-checks-migration.sh`
Expected: 1+ assertions fail (RED — script not implemented yet)
If the script already exists: all assertions pass (GREEN)
data.title: RED test: audit-closure-checks-migration.sh outputs correct format for tickets lacking Closure Checks section
